title: Magic Product Review - The Shell Game Released By TCC Magic
description:
The Shell Game is produced by Mai Bro and released through TCC Magic. This is an heirloom prop of magic that can be proudly used to display your talents of performing the Three Shell Game or added to your cherished magic prop collection. Watch the review to see if it is right for you.
You can purchase this through TCC Magic and many fine magic retailers around the world. If you go to TCCMagic.com you can use my Discount Code: FIDDLINJONNY to receive a discount at their sight. or use my link https://tccmagic.com/FIDDLINJONNY  

Fiddle Tune: "No Man's Land" (also known as "The Green Fields of France" or "Willie McBride") is a song written in 1976 by Scottish-born Australian folk singer-songwriter Eric Bogle, reflecting on the grave of a young man who died in World War I.
Here is a version of the song that I particularly like: https://youtu.be/oL2U6QX49DQ?si=8af4nsAqm0g1QiLT
